title: Smoked Salmon and Avocado Sushi Bowl
summary: A deconstructed sushi bowl with seasoned rice, silky smoked salmon, creamy avocado and crisp vegetables. It has the fresh, savoury-sweet flavours of sushi with none of the rolling, perfect for an easy Japanese-inspired dinner.

ingredients.name: light vegetable stock, for cooking rice
pickled-style ginger, made with fresh ginger

steps: Rinse the sushi rice in a sieve under cold water until the water runs mostly clear, then drain well.

Put the rice and light vegetable stock in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce the heat to low and cook for 12 minutes. Turn off the heat and leave covered for 10 minutes, until the grains are tender and sticky.

Warm the rice vinegar, sugar and salt briefly in a small bowl or pan, stirring until dissolved. Fold this seasoning through the hot rice, then spread the rice slightly in the pan or a shallow bowl to cool until warm rather than steaming hot.
Cook the edamame in boiling water for 3–4 minutes until bright green and tender, then drain.
Stir the tamari and sesame oil together to make a simple dressing.
Divide the seasoned rice between two bowls. Arrange the smoked salmon, avocado, cucumber, edamame, spring onions and ginger over the top in separate sections.
Drizzle with the tamari dressing and finish with sesame seeds. Serve straight away while the rice is slightly warm and the toppings are cool and fresh.
